scenario_summary: 200-location dental group subscribes to a cloud HR and workforce scheduling platform. Single fixed price billed upfront — the simplest ASC 606 scenario: one POB recognized straight-line over 12 months, creating a declining deferred revenue balance.

performance_obligations.name: HR & Scheduling Platform
performance_obligations.description: 12-month cloud-based HR, payroll, and shift-scheduling SaaS for 200 dental clinic locations and ~3,000 staff. Customer simultaneously receives and consumes the benefit as CloudHR continuously updates and maintains the platform.

ssp.basis: $10,000/month list price for enterprise tier (201-500 locations)

payment_schedule._note: Annual fee invoiced upfront on contract start date
